about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Soy Milk with You Tiao Crullers Singapore Style
recipes.summary: Warm sweetened soy milk with crisp, airy fried dough sticks, a hawker-centre breakfast pairing.
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda and salt, then stir in the warm water and oil to a soft dough.
Knead for 5 minutes until smooth, cover and rest the dough while the oil heats.
Roll the dough into a rectangle 1cm thick and cut into strips 2cm wide, pressing two strips together.
Heat the frying oil to 180C and stretch each pair to about 20cm before lowering it in.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes, turning, until puffed and deep golden.
Warm the soy milk with the sugar over low heat for 5 minutes until steaming, and serve with the crullers.
notes: Hot oil: use a deep pan, keep a lid nearby and never leave it unattended.
The dough should rest 20 minutes before rolling, which is not counted in prep time.

recipes.title: Chwee Kueh with Chye Poh Topping
recipes.summary: Steamed rice-flour cups topped with sweet-salty preserved radish, a Singapore breakfast favourite.
steps: Whisk the rice flour, starch, salt and 300ml of the water until smooth.
Bring the other 300ml water to the boil, whisk it into the batter and stir over low heat for 3 minutes, until it thickens like custard.
Stir in 1 tbsp oil and pour into oiled small cups.
Steam over high heat for 15 minutes, until the cakes are set and translucent.
Fry the garlic and chye poh in 2 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, until fragrant and crisp at the edges, then add sugar and soy sauce.
Unmould the cakes, top with the radish and serve with chilli sauce.
notes: Preserved radish is salty, so no extra salt is needed at the table.
Contains no egg or dairy.

recipes.title: Mee Soto Singapore Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: Turmeric chicken broth with noodles, bean sprouts and boiled egg, served with a spoon of sambal.
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger and turmeric to a paste and fry in the oil for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Add the bruised lemongrass, chicken, water and salt and simmer for 25 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and tender.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and keep the broth hot.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until firm, then peel and halve.
Blanch the noodles and bean sprouts for 1 minute, until the noodles are just tender.
Divide into bowls, add chicken, ladle over broth and top with egg, spring onion, sambal and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until there is no pink and it reaches 75°C, and chill leftovers within 2 hours.
Cook the eggs until the yolks are set.

recipes.title: Singapore Style Lor Mai Gai Sticky Rice Parcels
recipes.summary: Glutinous rice steamed with chicken, mushroom and Chinese sausage in lotus leaf-style wrapping, a dim-sum breakfast.
steps: Soak the dried mushrooms in hot water for 20 minutes, then slice, keeping 3 tbsp of the soaking water.
Slice the chicken and sausage and toss the chicken with 1 tbsp oyster sauce, soy and cornflour.
Stir-fry the sausage, mushroom and chicken in the oil for 6 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through, then add the remaining oyster sauce and soaking water.
Steam the soaked, drained rice for 20 minutes until tender, then fold in the sesame oil.
Spoon rice and filling onto sheets of baking paper (not listed, cut to size) and fold into tight parcels.
Steam the parcels for 20 minutes until piping hot throughout and the rice is sticky and glossy.
Serve scattered with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and keep parcels steaming hot until served.
Soak the rice for 4 hours before cooking, which is not counted in prep time.
Contains pork sausage, which must reach 75°C too.

recipes.title: Nasi Lemak Singapore Chicken Wing Plate
recipes.summary: Coconut rice with crisp spiced chicken wings, fried anchovies, cucumber and peanuts.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it with the coconut milk, water and a pinch of salt for 18 minutes, until tender, then rest it covered.
Rub the wings with turmeric, coriander and salt.
Bake the wings at 220C for 30 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and cooked through.
Fry the anchovies and peanuts in the oil for 3 minutes until crisp and golden.
Slice the cucumber and plate the rice with the wings, anchovies, peanuts, cucumber and sambal.
notes: Food safety: wings must reach 75°C and have no pink near the bone.
Contains peanuts and fish.
Coconut milk is calorie-dense, so this is a rich plate.

recipes.title: Roti Prata with Dhal Singapore Breakfast
recipes.summary: Flaky, stretched flatbread torn into a mild lentil dhal.
steps: Knead the flour, salt, sugar, water and 2 tbsp ghee for 8 minutes until the dough is soft and elastic, then divide into 8 balls and coat with ghee.
Simmer the lentils with the water and turmeric for 20 minutes, until completely soft.
Fry the onion, garlic and curry powder in the oil for 6 minutes, until golden, then add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until jammy.
Stir into the lentils and simmer for 5 minutes until thick, seasoning with salt.
Stretch each ball very thin, fold into a square and fry in a hot pan for 3 minutes each side, until golden and flaky.
Clap the pratas to loosen the layers and serve with the dhal.
notes: Rest the dough balls in ghee for at least 2 hours, which is not counted in prep time.
Ghee is dairy, so it is not dairy-free; use oil if needed.

recipes.title: Egg White Spinach Omelette Muffins High Protein
recipes.summary: Baked egg cups with spinach, feta and sun-dried tomato, easy to batch and reheat.
steps: Heat the oven to 180C and oil a 12-hole muffin tin.
Wilt the spinach in a pan for 2 minutes until soft, then squeeze out moisture and chop.
Whisk the eggs and whites with pepper and fold in the spinach, feta, tomato and spring onion.
Pour into the holes and bake for 20 minutes, until puffed, set in the centre and lightly golden.
Cool for 3 minutes before lifting out.
notes: Food safety: bake until the centres are fully set; reheat leftovers until steaming hot and eat within 3 days.
Feta is salty, so no salt is added.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble Breakfast Burrito Dairy Free
recipes.summary: Turmeric tofu scramble with black beans, avocado and salsa wrapped in warm tortillas.
steps: Crumble the tofu and fry in the oil with turmeric, cumin and salt for 6 minutes, until dry and golden.
Add the diced capsicum and cook for 4 minutes until tender.
Warm the beans in a small pan for 3 minutes until hot.
Stir the nutritional yeast through the tofu.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side.
Fill with tofu, beans, avocado and salsa, fold in the sides and roll tight.
notes: Tofu and beans give about 27 g protein per burrito.
Check tortillas if you need them dairy-free; most are.

recipes.title: Greek Yoghurt Protein Pancakes with Berries
recipes.summary: Fluffy oat pancakes made with Greek yoghurt and eggs for a high-protein start.
steps: Blend the oats to a fine flour, then add the yoghurt, eggs, baking powder, vanilla and honey and blend smooth.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes while a non-stick pan heats over medium heat.
Cook 1/4 cup scoops for 2 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes until golden and set through.
Stack the pancakes and top with berries and maple syrup.
notes: Food safety: cook the pancakes until the centre is no longer wet.
About 17 g protein per serve.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Egg Muffin Stack
recipes.summary: Toasted muffins with scrambled eggs, smoked salmon and chives.
steps: Split and toast the muffins until golden.
Whisk the eggs with milk and pepper.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat and stir the eggs gently for 3 minutes, until softly set and creamy.
Pile the eggs on the muffins and top with salmon, chives and a squeeze of lemon.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set; smoked salmon is not recommended for pregnant people unless cooked.
Contains fish, egg, dairy and gluten.

recipes.title: Menemen Turkish Tomato and Egg
recipes.summary: Soft eggs folded through a sweet pepper and tomato base, scooped up with bread.
steps: Fry the sliced capsicum in the oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the grated tomato and salt and cook for 6 minutes, until thick and jammy.
Crack in the eggs and stir gently for 3 minutes until just set but still soft.
Sprinkle with chilli and serve with toasted sourdough.
notes: Food safety: cook until the eggs are fully set.
Add sucuk for a meat version.

recipes.title: Peruvian Aguadito de Pollo Chicken and Coriander Soup
recipes.summary: Bright green coriander soup with chicken, rice, peas and potato.
steps: Blend the coriander with a little stock until a smooth green paste.
Fry the onion, garlic and aji paste in the oil for 6 minutes until soft and fragrant.
Add the chicken and stock and simmer for 15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through, then shred it.
Add the rice, diced potato and carrot and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Return the chicken, add the peas and coriander paste, and cook for 3 minutes until bright green.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and have no pink.
Aji amarillo paste can be replaced with mild yellow chilli.

recipes.title: Oaxacan Caldo de Piedra Style Fish Soup
recipes.summary: Chilli and tomato fish broth with white fish, prawns and lime, in the spirit of a coastal Oaxacan caldo.
steps: Toast the chillies in a dry pan for 1 minute until fragrant, then soak in hot water for 10 minutes.
Blend the chillies with tomato, half the onion and the garlic until smooth.
Fry the sauce in the oil for 8 minutes until darker and thick.
Add the stock, oregano and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the fish and prawns and simmer for 5 minutes until the fish flakes and the prawns are pink.
Serve with lime, remaining onion and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook fish and prawns until opaque and prawns are pink; eat within a day.
Contains fish and shellfish.

recipes.title: Sichuan Hot and Sour Soup Suan La Tang
recipes.summary: Silky tangy soup with tofu, mushroom, bamboo and egg ribbons, warming with white pepper.

items: 2 tbsp cornflour mixed with 4 tbsp water

steps: Simmer the stock and sliced mushrooms for 8 minutes until tender.
Add the soy, vinegar and tofu strips and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the cornflour slurry and cook for 2 minutes until the soup turns glossy and thickens.
Pour in the beaten eggs in a thin stream, stirring slowly, until ribbons form and set.
Finish with white pepper, sesame oil and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set.
Contains soy and egg.

recipes.title: Georgian Kharcho Beef and Walnut Soup
recipes.summary: Rich beef soup thickened with ground walnuts and rice, warmed with coriander and chilli.
steps: Simmer the beef cubes in the water for 1 hour, skimming, until tender.
Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden, then stir in the tomato paste and spices for 1 minute.
Grind the walnuts with the garlic into a coarse paste.
Add the onion mix, rice and walnut paste to the soup and simmer for 20 minutes until the rice is soft.
Stir in the chopped coriander and salt.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until tender and at least 75°C inside.
Contains tree nuts.

recipes.title: Lebanese Lentil and Silverbeet Soup Adas bi Hamod
recipes.summary: Lemony green lentil soup with silverbeet and coriander.
steps: Simmer the lentils in the water for 25 minutes until just tender.
Fry the onions in 2 tbsp oil for 10 minutes until deep golden.
Fry the garlic and coriander in the last tbsp oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the silverbeet and onion to the lentils and cook for 5 minutes until the leaves wilt.
Stir the flour into the lemon juice, add it with the garlic mix, and simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
notes: Vegan.
Contains gluten from the flour.

recipes.title: Andalusian Ajo Blanco Chilled Almond Soup
recipes.summary: Cold white soup of almonds, garlic and sherry vinegar, served with grapes.
steps: Soak the bread in a little water for 5 minutes, then squeeze it dry.
Blend the almonds, bread and garlic with the water until very smooth.
Blend in the oil in a thin stream until the soup is creamy and pale.
Season with vinegar and salt and chill for 1 hour until very cold.
Serve in chilled bowls with diced apple scattered over until just covered.
notes: Contains tree nuts and gluten.
Olive oil makes this rich, so a small bowl goes a long way.

recipes.title: Andalusian Gazpacho with Cucumber Salsa
recipes.summary: Classic cold tomato soup with olive oil and a crisp cucumber topping.
steps: Soak the bread in water for 5 minutes and squeeze it dry.
Blend the tomatoes, half the cucumber, the capsicum, garlic and bread until smooth.
Add the oil slowly while blending until the soup looks creamy.
Season with vinegar and salt and chill for 1 hour until cold.
Dice the remaining cucumber and scatter over the bowls.
notes: Vegan.
Chill well; flavours deepen overnight.

recipes.title: Thai Larb Gai Chicken Salad
recipes.summary: Minced chicken salad with lime, fish sauce, toasted rice powder, mint and chilli.
steps: Cook the mince in the water over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Cool for 2 minutes, then toss with lime, fish sauce and chilli.
Stir in the rice powder, sliced shallot, spring onion and herbs.
Spoon into lettuce leaves to serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C with no pink.
Contains fish sauce, so not vegetarian.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Sweet Corn and Black Bean Bowl
recipes.summary: Sweet charred corn, black beans, avocado and coriander with a lime dressing.
steps: Char the corn in a hot pan for 10 minutes, turning, until blackened in places.
Cut the kernels from the cobs.
Whisk lime juice, oil, cumin and salt.
Toss kernels with beans, onion, avocado and coriander and dress just before serving.
notes: Vegan.
Dress close to serving so the avocado stays green.

recipes.title: Beetroot, Rocket and Walnut Salad with Honey Balsamic
recipes.summary: Earthy beetroot with peppery rocket, tangy goat cheese and crunchy walnuts.
steps: Roast the beetroot, wrapped in foil with oil, at 200C for 45 minutes until tender.
Cool, peel and cut into wedges.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Whisk balsamic, honey and salt.
Toss the beetroot and rocket with dressing, and top with crumbled cheese and walnuts.
notes: Contains tree nuts and dairy.
Wear gloves when peeling beetroot.

recipes.title: Roast Autumn Pumpkin and Sage Side
recipes.summary: Caramelised wedges tossed with crisp sage and pepitas.
steps: Toss the pumpkin with 2 tbsp oil, maple syrup and salt and roast at 220C for 30 minutes, until deep golden and tender.
Fry the sage in the remaining oil for 1 minute until crisp.
Toast the pepitas in a dry pan for 2 minutes until they pop.
Scatter the sage and pepitas over the pumpkin.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Spring Peas with Mint and Lemon Butter
recipes.summary: Sweet peas and broad beans in lemony butter.
steps: Simmer the peas and green beans in salted water for 4 minutes, until just tender.
Drain well and return to the pan.
Stir in the butter and lemon zest until glossy.
Fold through the torn mint until evenly distributed.
notes: Dairy-free version: use olive oil.

recipes.title: Summer Zucchini Ribbons with Basil and Parmesan
recipes.summary: Raw and quickly seared zucchini with basil and shaved vegetarian hard cheese.
steps: Shave the zucchini into ribbons.
Sear half in the oil with garlic for 2 minutes, until just softening.
Toss with raw ribbons, lemon, salt and torn basil.
Shave the cheese over the top.
notes: Uses vegetarian hard cheese.

recipes.title: Rotkohl German Sweet-Sour Red Cabbage
recipes.summary: Sweet-sour cabbage braised with apple, vinegar and cloves.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the shredded cabbage, apple, vinegar, sugar, cloves, salt and water.
Cover and cook on low for 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until the cabbage is tender and glossy.
Taste and adjust the vinegar before serving.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Egyptian Style Mashed Bean Breakfast with Tomato
recipes.summary: Mashed fava beans with olive oil, lemon, cumin and chopped tomato, scooped up with flatbread.
steps: Warm the beans with their liquid and garlic for 10 minutes until hot.
Mash roughly with cumin, lemon juice and salt.
Spoon into bowls, drizzle with oil and top with tomato and parsley.
Serve with warmed flatbread.
notes: Vegan.
Contains gluten.

recipes.title: Tahini and Toum Lebanese Garlic Sauce Trio
recipes.summary: Sesame yoghurt, tahini lemon and garlic sauces for grilled meat or falafel.
steps: Whisk tahini, juice of 1 lemon, water and salt until pale and thick.
Mash the garlic with salt, then stir into the yoghurt with the remaining lemon juice.
Fold in the parsley until evenly mixed through.
Chill in a covered jar until needed, until cold and thickened.
notes: Contains sesame and dairy.
Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Georgian Satsivi Walnut Sauce
recipes.summary: Silky walnut sauce with garlic, coriander and spice, served with chicken or vegetables.
steps: Fry the onion in oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Grind the walnuts with the garlic to a paste.
Mix in the onion, spices and vinegar.
Stir in hot water gradually and cook gently for 3 minutes until thick.
Season with salt and serve warm or at room temperature.
notes: Contains tree nuts.
Vegan.
